messages:
sasha: FYI — onboarding report: user ran the python quickstart (hello_cli) and saw 'Call complete' but no text output. they pasted stdout and dashboard shows a 402 for the same workspace.

alex: can you paste the quickstart stdout? might be an exception swallowed somewhere. which sdk version?

sasha: stdout:
```
$ python examples/hello_cli.py --api-key sk-xxxx
Starting request to model=open-7b
Request complete
Call complete
```
No stacktrace. SDK: python-sdk 0.9.0, sample app is the repo example from docs.

sam: do we have server logs? 402 would indicate billing gating. If sample app treats any non-exception as success it could print 'Call complete' after receiving an error body.

sasha: server returned JSON (redacted):
```
{"error":{"code":402,"type":"billing_required","message":"Billing contact must accept charges","meta":{"reason":"billing_ack_required"}}}
```
TCP reset after body. dashboard shows a single failed request and a small token footprint. user worried they're being billed.

billing-bot: That workspace is pending billing acceptance. We record attempted footprints for quota/preview but do not bill until charges are accepted. Some quick dashboard views show attempts which looks like usage.

alex: root cause seems to be sample app's response handling: it calls client.generate(...).result() and then prints 'Call complete' in finally{} without checking for error in the response object. If the SDK returns an ErrorResponse object rather than raising, the app treats it as success.

sasha: ok. can we repro locally? I ran the same with a test org set to billing_pending and saw identical stdout.

sam: two fixes: (A) python SDK should raise an exception for 4xx server error bodies (don't return a success wrapper) (B) quickstart example should check for exceptions and print helpful output about billing gating. Also add a clear message in onboarding docs about 'first call may requireBillingAck'.

alex: I'll open PRs: py-sdk change (raise on error responses) and docs sample change. Also add a test that simulates 402 with JSON body so we don't regress.

sasha: for immediate CS workflow, what's the best message to send users?

billing-bot: Ask workspace admins to accept billing invite. If they can't, create a temporary dev workspace with billing enabled. Also note: service accounts created by orgs without billing will get 402 until billing_ack.

sam: one more nuance: our retry middleware retries idempotent POSTs once on network failure. The quickstart used default settings and the SDK retried once after the connection reset, which caused two attempted footprints showing as more usage in some telemetry views. We should not auto-retry on 402 or on responses with error bodies.

alex: good catch. I'll update retry policy to bail on 4xx with JSON error bodies and add telemetry counters for 'retries_avoided_due_to_client_error'. ticket DX-7721.

sasha: user accepted billing and retried, got text output immediately. they were relieved.

devex-bot: patch published: python-sdk@0.9.1 - raises on server error responses, avoids retrying on 4xx, docs PR merged: examples/hello_cli now surfaces billing error and prints guidance.

alex: followups: 1) add onboarding FAQ blurb (CS playbook) 2) add sample unit that simulates 402 in CI 3) add a short note in CLI output when workspace state != active. I'll handle 1 & 3.

sasha: thanks team. closing after docs FAQ merged. Will link ticket DX-7721 and infra ticket INF-4610 for server-side consistent status codes. :white_check_mark:
